subject: Ghanaian Language
name: JHS 2 Ghanaian Language
description: The JHS 2 Ghanaian Language curriculum deepens learners' knowledge of customs, institutions, and language skills. It covers puberty rites, naming systems, clan systems, chieftaincy destoolment, advanced conversation, reading comprehension, translation, grammar, composition writing and literature.

strands.title: CUSTOMS AND INSTITUTIONS
strands.description: Understanding rites of passage, naming systems, clans, and chieftaincy.

subStrands.title: RITES OF PASSAGE: PUBERTY RITES
subStrands.description: Exploring puberty rites and their significance.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of how puberty rites are performed in their linguistic community, its significance and compare with other cultures of Ghana

indicators.description: Identify the processes involved in performing puberty rites in your culture

exemplars.description: Explain what puberty rites are
Talk about the items needed for the performance of puberty rites among their people and their significance
Discuss the processes involved in performing puberty rites for boys/girls among their people
Read and discuss a two-hundred-word passage on puberty rites
Explain the significance of puberty rites
Role play a puberty rite activity

indicators.description: Compare and contrast the processes involved in performing puberty rites in their culture to other cultures of Ghana

exemplars.description: Discuss the similarities in the performance of puberty rites among their people and those of other Ghanaian cultures
Discuss the differences in the performance of puberty rites among their people and those of other Ghanaian cultures
Write the summary of the similarities and differences

indicators.description: Discuss the changes that has occurred in puberty rites performance over time

exemplars.description: Assess the current ways puberty rites are performed among his/her people
Compare the contemporary ways to the traditional ways by which your people were performing puberty rites (e.g. It is now done by the church, Duration for the rites has changed, Done for all ages)
Identify the threats to puberty rites in contemporary times (e.g. technology, migration, education and religion)

subStrands.title: NAMING SYSTEMS - FAMILY NAMES, KINSHIP TERMS, PROVERBIAL AND INSINUATION NAMES
subStrands.description: Understanding family names, kinship terms, and other naming types.

contentStandards.description: Recognise and understand family names, kinship terms and proverbial and insinuation names

indicators.description: Discuss the sources of family names in your language and use them appropriately

exemplars.description: Read a text on names and their sources
Mention family names and their sources (e.g. clan, grand and great-grand parents)
Discuss the importance of family names
Make a documentation on family names for male and female and indicate their sources

indicators.description: Examine kinship terms in their community

exemplars.description: Read a passage (200 words) on kinship terms
Cite the kinship terms that are used to address your family members (e.g. father, mother, uncle, aunt, niece, nephew, grandparents)
Discuss and document the importance of kinship terms

indicators.description: State and discuss the effects of the modern trends of naming on family names and kinship terms

exemplars.description: Identify and talk about modern ways of naming babies among your people (e.g. Naming is done after anybody instead of from the family line/lineage, Naming from other cultures, Giving Christian/Muslim names)
Explain how the modern ways of naming affect the family names among your people (e.g. Loss of identity, Belittling the indigenous culture)

indicators.description: Discuss proverbial and insinuation names

exemplars.description: Explain proverbial and insinuation names
Discuss the characteristics of proverbial and insinuation names (e.g. They are one-word names that represent whole sentences)
Identify situations that lead to proverbial and insinuation names (e.g. To cast insinuations, To show appreciation)
Give examples of proverbial and insinuation names used among your people

indicators.description: Explore and discuss appellations that go with names

exemplars.description: Explain appellation
Give examples of day names and their appellations
Identify and discuss appellations that go with family and other names where applicable

subStrands.title: THE CLAN SYSTEM
subStrands.description: Understanding the importance and threats to the clan system.

contentStandards.description: Exhibit knowledge of the clan system in their locality by discussing the importance and threats to the clan systems

indicators.description: Discuss the importance and threats to the clan system

exemplars.description: Read and discuss a passage on clan system of their culture
Discuss and write the importance of the clan system of their culture
Discuss the threats to the clan system

subStrands.title: CHIEFTAINCY: DESTOOLMENT
subStrands.description: Understanding the processes of destooling or deskining a chief.

contentStandards.description: Discuss the processes involved in the destooling/deskining of a chief or queenmother

indicators.description: Examine some behaviours that can lead to the destoolment/deskinment of chiefs and queenmothers

exemplars.description: Read and discuss a text on destoolment/deskinment in their traditional area

Examine and write behaviours that lead to the destoolment/deskinment of a chief or queenmother among their people (e.g. Misuse of property of the people, Disrespect for kingmakers and subjects, Neglect/abuse of tradition)

indicators.description: Discuss the processes involved in the destoolment/deskinment of a chief or a queenmother

exemplars.description: Examine and write the process of destooling/deskining a chief and queenmother among their people (e.g. Complaints by subjects, Cautioning by kingmaker, Summoning the chief/queenmother for arbitration)
Write the advantages and disadvantages of destoolment/deskinment
Role play destoolment/deskinment of a chief among their people

indicators.description: Compare and contrast the destoolment/deskinment processes among their people and other cultures of Ghana

exemplars.description: Discuss and write the similarities and differences of the destoolment/deskinment process of your people and that of other Ghanaian cultures
Write the similarities and differences

subStrands.title: CONVERSATION/EVERYDAY DISCOURSE
subStrands.description: Using appropriate language in various contexts.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of presentational skills in listening, following daily conversation, speaking clearly and explaining ideas

indicators.description: Develop and modify their language in narrating some selected daily activities

exemplars.description: Narrate what you do at home every Saturday
Describe what you saw on your last visit to a market
Draw and discuss a scenery on a given topic (e.g.: fishing, farming, weaving)
Describe a visit to a hospital
Describe a scene at a lorry station

subStrands.title: LISTENING COMPREHENSION
subStrands.description: Listening skills for understanding key information.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate the ability to listen to extended reading and identify key information

indicators.description: Listen to a level-appropriate dialogue attentively and identify key information

exemplars.description: Listen to and note important issues in a dialogue e.g. message, mood, tone
Listen and compare the issues noted in the dialogue with peers

indicators.description: Listen to and discuss the ideas and share opinions from a level-appropriate text

exemplars.description: Listen to and write down key information from texts/talk shows/news
Discuss the key information from texts and add opinions

contentStandards.description: Recognise changes in meaning due to tone contrast

indicators.description: Establish the meaning of words when the tone on the syllables in a word changes

exemplars.description: Pronounce words with high tone
Pronounce words with mid-tone (where applicable)
Pronounce words with low tone
Read same words with different tone in context
State the differences of those words as used in context

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of presentational skills in listening, following daily conversation, speaking clearly and explaining ideas

indicators.description: Develop and modify their language in narrating some selected daily activities

exemplars.description: Narrate what you do at home every Saturday
Describe what you saw on your last visit to a market
Draw and discuss a scenery on a given topic (e.g.: fishing, farming, weaving)
Describe a visit to the hospital
Describe a scene at a lorry station

subStrands.title: READING
subStrands.description: Understanding main ideas and summarising texts.

contentStandards.description: Understand the main ideas and supporting points in texts

indicators.description: Understand the main ideas and supporting points in a range of extended texts on familiar and unfamiliar topics

exemplars.description: Read a three-paragraph passage from different subject areas (Science, Social Studies, RME, ICT, etc.) and answer questions to identify specific information and details

indicators.description: Summarise long passages read

exemplars.description: Read longer texts and summarise main and supporting ideas

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of translating words, phrases and sentences

indicators.description: Establish the meaning of words, phrases and sentences in their various languages

exemplars.description: Translate given words, phrases and sentences from source language to target language

subStrands.title: INTEGRATING GRAMMAR IN WRITTEN LANGUAGE (USE OF NOUNS, PRONOUNS AND ADJECTIVES)
subStrands.description: Using nouns, pronouns, and adjectives correctly.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of nouns, pronouns and adjectives

indicators.description: Explore the use of nouns and pronouns in an increasing range of texts and classify them

exemplars.description: Write down nouns and pronouns in their language
Classify nouns under the various types (abstract, concrete, countable and uncountable)
Construct compound sentences with nouns and pronouns in speech and in texts
Replace nouns with the appropriate pronouns in a given text

indicators.description: Determine and categorise adjectives under size, colour, shape, quantity, etc. in their language

exemplars.description: Determine the role of an adjective in a variety of texts
Identify and classify adjectives in a given text

subStrands.title: INTEGRATING GRAMMAR IN WRITTEN LANGUAGE (VERBS, ADVERBS AND CONJUNCTIONS)
subStrands.description: Using verbs, adverbs, and conjunctions correctly.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of verbs, adverb, conjunctions

indicators.description: Recognise and use the tense and aspectual (habitual, progressive, future) forms of verbs in sentences

exemplars.description: Identify the types of tense and aspectual forms in their language
Form sentences with the various types of tense and aspectual forms

indicators.description: Identify and use adverbs appropriately in sentences

exemplars.description: Determine the functions of adverbs in sentences
Identify and classify adverbs in a given text
Construct compound sentences using adverbs

indicators.description: Identify and use conjunctions in an increasing range of texts appropriately and correctly

exemplars.description: Use appropriate conjunctions to link simple and compound sentences in texts

strands.title: COMPOSITION WRITING
strands.description: Structuring and organizing ideas in writing.

subStrands.title: STRUCTURE AND ORGANISE IDEAS IN COMPOSITION WRITING

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding in the ability to write meaningful compositions on the various text types (persuasive/argumentative writing, informative/academic/expository and letter writing)

indicators.description: Develop coherent essays using the features of given text types

exemplars.description: Discuss the features of persuasive/argumentative writing, informative/academic/expository and letter writing
Write a composition on a topic on the text types above

strands.title: LITERATURE
strands.description: Exploring proverbs, idioms, and literary devices.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of proverbs and idioms

indicators.description: Discuss the features of proverbs and idioms

exemplars.description: Describe the features of proverbs and idioms and give examples of each
Identify and interpret proverbs and idioms in your language
State the occasions and situations in which the given proverbs and idioms are used
State the importance of proverbs and idioms

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding in the use of language in a prose, poetry and drama texts

indicators.description: Discuss how writers use language to create effect in prose, poetry and drama

exemplars.description: Discuss how writers use language to create character in prose, poetry and drama texts, giving examples from the text
Explore ways in which writers use a wide range of literary devices (simile, metaphor, repetition, idioms and proverbs) in a range of prose, poetry and drama texts
Discuss the ways writers use language to create settings for different effects in prose, poetry and drama
Discuss how writers use language to create mood and tone in prose, poetry and drama
Discuss the ways writers structure texts in prose, poetry and drama
